content: काकः [कै शब्दकरणे-कन् <ls>Uṇ. 3. 43</ls>] .²1 A crow; काकोऽपि जीवति चिराय बलिं च भुङ्क्ते <ls>Pt. 1. 24</ls>. .²2 (<ab>Fig.</ab>) A contemptible fellow, base or impudent person. .²3 A lame man. .²4 Bathing by dipping the head only into water (as crows do). .²5 A sectarial mark (तिलक). .²6 A kind of measure. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of a Dvīpa. .{@-का@} <ab>N.</ab> of several plants काकनासा, काकोली <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-की@} A female crow. .{@-काकी@} see <ls>Mbh.</ls> on <ls n="P.">IV. 1. 63</ls>. .{@-कम्@} .²1 A multitude of crows. .²2 A modus coeundi.
